duplicates.rationale: All four report the same incompatible current-versus-superseded quality-gate authority projection.
Both report missing change-triggered ownership for the same three independent Cargo graphs; P1 is preserved.
All arise from the original non-material or empty specialist assignment denominator and are resolved for this packet by one deterministic replacement.

disagreements.rationale: Some reports characterize the handoff itself as blocked, while its current prose points to #467; the proven disagreement is across the total canonical surface, especially retained validation and stale current-tense documents.

Unchecked engineering/security acceptance rows challenge engineering-complete claims, while unfinished internal/external review and ceremony are expected downstream release-tail state and do not by themselves disprove engineering completion.

The specialist classified this as ambiguous warning rather than P0-P3; the validator requires P0-P3, so the machine projection uses P2 without changing the report's explicit ambiguity or promoting it to a release-blocking claim.
